evidence.observation: The opening names Jamie, the target technical-project and product-operations role family, the operating structures he creates, and direct paths to work, resume, and contact.

The concise new opening makes Jamie's agency and the usable outcomes of plans, risk visibility, records, onboarding, launch support, and handoffs immediately legible, then connects them to named projects.

Jamie's resume-attributed role is kept separate from Board and Council actions; the public boundary correctly prevents appropriation from implying an executed agreement, receipt, expenditure, construction, completion, or current property status.
The page distinguishes the Council's attributed event description from Jamie's independent follow-on and candidly identifies CallNYC as archived, unofficial, and unsuitable as current guidance.

Jamie's web, documentation, source-mapping, and coordination work remains visible without assigning him sole policy leadership, institutional authority, legal authorship, or causality for collective outcomes.

The source-dense case provides local references, source notes, accessible backlinks, and explicit non-support boundaries, but other major cases rely more heavily on public-safe summaries whose protected support cannot be inspected by a public reader.
The revenue wording remains contribution language and protected commercial evidence stays offline, appropriately limiting public inspection of the underlying source detail.

The page is clearly labeled and free of internal evaluation narration, but the operations list, proof map, and capability cards repeat adjacent ideas and require more scanning than an exceptional one-pass application page.
Jamie is plainly identified as the builder, the translation from civic records to resident-facing pathways is immediately useful, and official affiliation is not inflated.

Experimental media, installations, gatherings, participation, memory, and place are connected to current systems practice, though this embodied and material throughline is demonstrated mostly through prose rather than approved specimens.

The movement from public records to an information model, interface, and social action pathway is legible, while the recursive method across the wider portfolio remains more often described than visually demonstrated.

Artifact cards describe the interface and translation model, but no approved, inspectable project image is rendered; this remains an explicitly allowed application-profile deferral and must not be closed with unapproved or historically misleading material.

The role line, operating-structure proposition, selected impact, downloadable approved PDF, and corrected CallNYC chronology agree with the homepage and public chronology; the phone remains confined to the PDF rather than HTML.

Candidate-bound browser evidence reports 200 responses, no overflow across desktop, mobile, and 200%-equivalent reflow checks, working citation navigation, visible focus on all 24 traversed controls, and content on all routes without JavaScript.

Canonical, Open Graph, Twitter-card, resume-download, and contact paths are coherent, but the inspected browser evidence retains staging metadata defaults and therefore does not establish production sharing behavior.

Repository, public-safety, citation, route, resume, and local browser evidence support application use. Production cutover, deployed-commit verification, production smoke and monitoring evidence, indexing state, rollback proof, and Jamie's exact-candidate approval remain candidly declared production and human-approval gaps.

The employment extension stores current role requirements, hard screens, fit evidence, gaps, and simulated reader contexts in governed internal records. It adds no public job-targeting route and does not publish private communications or imply that named readers participated.

The new archive-derived registry fields add only non-support and attribution boundaries to existing public claims. The exact manifest, raw documents, Drive coordinates, working comments, participant data, and media remain outside the application candidate, and no protected-only claim is rendered.
